(current_user_can_manage_standard_question_bank() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((digital_textbook_chapters chapter
     JOIN digital_textbook_versions version ON ((version.id = chapter.version_id)))
     JOIN digital_textbooks textbook ON ((textbook.id = version.textbook_id)))
  WHERE ((chapter.id = digital_textbook_modules.chapter_id) AND (chapter.status = 'published'::text) AND (version.status = 'published'::text) AND (textbook.status = 'published'::text) AND private.current_user_can_read_student_app(textbook.student_app_id)))))
